P2para.Text: In this Part, unless the context otherwise requires—

Para.Text: "article for use at work" means—
any plant designed for use or operation (whether exclusively or not) by persons at work, and
any article designed for use as a component in any such plant.
"code of practice" (without prejudice to section 16(8)) includes a standard, a specification and any other documentary form of practical guidance;

"conditional sale agreement" means an agreement for the sale of goods under which the purchase price or part of it is payable by instalments, and the property in the goods is to remain in the seller (notwithstanding that the buyer is to be in possession of the goods) until such conditions as to the payment of instalments or otherwise as may be specified in the agreement are fulfilled;
"contract of employment" means a contract of service or of apprenticeship, whether express or implied, and (if it is express) whether oral or in writing;
"credit sale agreement" has the meaning given by section 189(1) of the Consumer Credit Act 1974;
"customs officer" means an officer within the meaning of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979;

"domestic premises" means premises occupied as a private dwelling (including any garden, yard, garage, outhouse or other appurtenance of such premises which is not used in common by the occupants of more than one such dwelling), and "non-domestic premises" shall be construed accordingly;
"employee" means an individual who works under a contract of employment or is treated by section 51A as being an employee, and related expressions shall be construed accordingly;
"enforcing authority" has the meaning assigned by section 18(7);
"executive" means the Health and Safety Executive;

"existing statutory provisions" means the following provisions while and to the extent that they remain in force, namely the provisions of the Acts mentioned in Schedule 1 which are specified in the third column of that Schedule and of the regulations, orders or other instruments of a legislative character made or having effect under any provision so specified;

"fairground equipment" means any fairground ride, any similar plant which is designed to be in motion for entertainment purposes with members of the public on or inside it or any plant which is designed to be used by members of the public for entertainment purposes either as combatants or as targets;
"general purposes of this Part" means the purposes of this Part mentioned in section 1;
"health and safety regulations" means regulations under the relevant statutory provision;
"hire-purchase agreement" has the meaning given by section 189(1) of the Consumer Credit Act 1974;
"improvement notice" means a notice under section 21;
"inspector" means an inspector appointed under section 19;
"local authority" means—

in relation to England, a county council, a district council, a London borough council, the Common Council of the City of London, the Sub-Treasurer of the Inner Temple, the Under-Treasurer of the Middle Temple, or the Council of the Isles of Scilly;
in relation to Scotland, a council constituted under section 2 of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994;
in relation to Wales, a county council or a county borough council;
"offshore installation" has the meaning given by section 44;
"personal injury" includes any disease and any impairment of a person's physical or mental condition;
"premises" includes any place and, in particular, includes—
any vehicle, vessel, aircraft or hovercraft,

any installation on land (including the foreshore and other land intermittently covered by water), any offshore installation, and any other installation (whether floating, or resting on the seabed or the subsoil thereof, or resting on other land covered with water or the subsoil beneath such water), and
any tent or movable structure;
"prescribed" means prescribed by regulations made by the Secretary of State;
"prohibition notice" means a notice under section 22;
"relevant statutory provisions" means the provisions of this Part and of any health and safety regulations and agricultural health and safety regulations;
"self-employed person" means an individual who works for gain or reward otherwise than under a contract of employment, whether or not he himself employs others;
"substance" means any natural or artificial substance, whether in solid or liquid form or in the form of a gas or vapour;
"supply" has the meaning given by section 46;
"work" means work as an employee or as a self-employed person.
